episodeTitle.en: How to unlock your product leadership skills | Ken Norton, Ex-Google
episodeTitle.zh: 如何解锁产品领导力 | 肯·诺顿（前谷歌高管）

guestBioOfficial.en: Advancing as a product leader requires new skills and a new mindset. Ken Norton is an executive coach who works with some of the top people in product to help them get unstuck and find creativity again in their approach to problems and their careers. After 14 years as a Product Manager at Google, Ken brings deep experience in leadership and shares with us the lessons he most often offers his clients to unlock growth. Join us.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 要想在产品领导岗位上有所突破，需要具备新技能和新思维。肯·诺顿是为顶尖产品团队提供辅导的执行教练，帮助他们突破瓶颈，重新激发解决问题和职业发展的创造力。肯在谷歌担任产品经理14年，积累了深厚的领导经验，并将为客户提供的最常用增长策略与我们分享。欢迎加入我们。

title.en: How to unlock your product leadership skills | Ken Norton, Ex-Google
title.zh: 如何解锁产品领导力 | 肯·诺顿（前谷歌高管）

summary.en: Ken emphasizes that product management is leadership from day one, even without formal authority. He discusses the creative versus reactive mindset and why the art of PM-ing matters more than the science. The episode covers overcoming imposter syndrome, common PM blind spots, and how to find and evaluate a good coach.
summary.zh: 肯强调，产品经理从第一天起就是领导者，即便没有正式职权。他探讨了"创造性"与"被动反应"两种心态，以及为何产品管理的"艺术"比"科学"更重要。本期涵盖如何克服冒名顶替综合征、PM 常见的盲点，以及如何找到并评估一位好教练。
